summary: Ukrainian officials prepare for diplomatic meetings with US and Israeli representatives, while Russian strikes target civilian infrastructure and military positions. Ukrainian forces report increased drone attacks on occupied territories.
key_points: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy confirms preparations for diplomatic meetings with US and Israeli representatives, including Stev Witkoff and Jared Kushner (Source: @UkraineNow/83195)
Russian strikes destroy a frozen food warehouse in Dnipro, disrupting national food supply chains (Source: @UkraineNow/83180)
Russian military claims destruction of 300 Ukrainian soldiers and 40 armored vehicles in Kursk region (Source: @tass_agency/388751)
Russian drone attacks reported on civilian areas in Kherson and Dnipro (Sources: @mon1tor_ua/69781, @kpszsu/71534)
Ukrainian SBU claims 21,000 front-line targets destroyed during peace operation (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32179)
Russian attacks on Ukrainian ports cause $3 billion agricultural losses (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32176)
Russian military reports destruction of three US-made artillery systems in Donetsk (Source: @tass_agency/388757)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian military operations continue to target both frontline positions and civilian infrastructure, with increased drone attacks on occupied territories. Ukrainian diplomatic efforts with Western partners suggest ongoing efforts to secure military and economic support amid sustained Russian aggression.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian officials are actively engaging with international partners to secure diplomatic and military support, while Russian forces maintain offensive operations across multiple fronts. The destruction of critical infrastructure and agricultural supply chains highlights the strategic importance of these targets in the conflict.
sections.intelligence_notes: The continued use of drone attacks on civilian areas suggests Russian forces are prioritizing psychological warfare alongside military objectives. Ukrainian efforts to secure international support through diplomatic channels indicate a strategic shift toward long-term conflict sustainability. The destruction of agricultural infrastructure has significant implications for Ukraine's food security and economic stability.
